climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A wine area in Burgenland, Austria, for wine from Blaufränkisch, Chardonnay, Grüner Veltliner and Neuburger, with Pinot Blanc also allowed. Blaufränkisch is the most planted grape at 21 percent, followed by Grüner Veltliner at 14.
